rightsReview.reason: JR Shikoku and JR West reserve rights in timetables, map artwork and databases, including third-party JR timetable content. Save only independently structured minimal static calling names/order for two specifically reviewed trains, a contiguous JR Shikoku section, source URL/date, attribution and content fingerprints. No timetable clocks, platform values, copied tables, operating-calendar database or expressive page artwork is retained. Current train URLs were resolved from the 20261001 Kojima station pages and exact 33D/34D train identities were verified; old search result IDs now identify other trains and are excluded. The JR Shikoku optional-stop overview corroborates identity but is not treated as an all-trains stopping sequence.
